title: Light bulb
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='45%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff59a'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ffd93b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb300'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='base' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#cfd8dc'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#90a4ae'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow halo -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='34' fill='#ffd93b' opacity='0.22'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='27' fill='#ffe97a' opacity='0.28'/>

  <!-- bulb glass -->
  <path d='M50 12
           C31 12 20 26 20 41
           C20 53 28 60 32 67
           C34 71 35 74 35 77
           L65 77
           C65 74 66 71 68 67
           C72 60 80 53 80 41
           C80 26 69 12 50 12 Z'
        fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- glass highlight -->
  <path d='M34 26 C30 32 28 38 29 45' stroke='#fffde0' stroke-width='3'
        stroke-linecap='round' fill='none' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- filament -->
  <path d='M42 60 L46 48 L50 56 L54 48 L58 60' stroke='#ff8a00'
        stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='37' y='77' width='26' height='5' rx='2' fill='#e6b84a'/>

  <!-- screw base -->
  <rect x='37' y='81' width='26' height='5' rx='2' fill='url(#base)'/>
  <rect x='37' y='86' width='26' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b0bec5'/>
  <rect x='39' y='91' width='22' height='4' rx='2' fill='#78909c'/>
</svg>
